thread:
alex: heads-up — we keep getting paging storms from tenants during traffic spikes. proposal: add a suppression stateflow that separates SLO evaluation from notify fanout. want quick opinions.
nina: good call. how do you see ttl/backoff working?
alex: think of it as states: NORMAL -> ALERTING -> SUPPRESSED -> THROTTLED -> RECOVERY. important: SUPPRESSED still logs full event but replaces full fanout with sampled notify. THROTTLED is when tenant rate cap blocks routing entirely.
rafa: +1. prefer using two signals: (1) slo_state for correctness teams, (2) routing_decision for routing service. keeps concerns separated.
sam: agree on separation. also add a per-tenant daily suppression budget so one noisy tenant doesn't hide real regressions forever. if budget exhausted, move to THROTTLED and escalate to a single oncall channel.
jia: telemetry requirements: suppressed=true, suppression_reason (burst|config|budget), budget_remaining. export to logs and metrics. UI needs a table row showing suppressed_count and sample links.
nina: UX: console should show an inline pill: "Suppressed: 12 (view)" and an affordance to temporarily disable suppression for that tenant (admin only). also expose the routing_decision in the SLO detail modal.
rafa: edgecases — multi-tenant routes where a spike in one tenant triggers route-wide suppression. we should support scoping: tenant-scoped vs route-scoped suppression. default tenant-scoped. config APIs must accept scope field.
sam: implementation note: keep the evaluation window and the suppression controller pluggable. introduce min_duration (eg 3m) to avoid flip-flopping. exponential backoff on repeated suppressions.
jia: schema suggestion for eval API response: {"state":"ALERTING","routing_decision":"sampled","suppressed":true,"backoff_until":"2026-06-01T12:10:00Z","scope":"tenant","reason":"burst"} — we'll store raw JSON blob in raw_events.
alert-bot: CI: suppression-controller feature-flag enabled in staging for 10% traffic. smoke pass.
alex: rollout plan: 1) API + telemetry in staging behind flag, 2) console visibility + admin toggle, 3) canary 10% tenants, 4) monitor noise reduction metrics + missed-alert rate for 48h, 5) widen.
nina: let's add a metric for "suppressed_but_actionable" where downstream alerts would have changed SLO decisions — helps tune heuristics.
sam: can someone pick up PRs? I'll own routing_decision short-circuit. rafa pick scope config API. jia update telemetry pipeline. alex will draft RFC with examples and state diagram.
rafa: noted, will open API PR.
alert-bot: Reminder: suppression-controller rollout run scheduled 2026-04-02T09:00Z.
